speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether there have been instances where the Ministry has prohibited the use of mattresses in migrant worker dormitories; (b) if so, what are the reasons for the prohibition; and (c) how long are the prohibitions for.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I then check if the MOM is following up with some of the migrant worker dormitories and checking whether some of them have prohibited the use of mattresses at the dormitories?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And if so, what is the percentage or number of dormitories that actually ban the use of mattresses.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: But the Member was asking whether MOM does proactive checks – in fact, we do.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: At that point in time, it involved only dormitories that are governed by the Foreign Employee Dormitories Act, which was only recently enhanced on 1 April.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: In fact, those cases were investigated because of two scenarios.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: The other situation that arose was because the bed spaces were unoccupied and so the bed boards were not placed there.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Could I ask MOM to follow up on this and make sure that there is some awareness out there, that migrant workers have a choice with regard to the use of mattresses in their dormitories?
